svg.title: Green Lantern power battery - wiring (budget build)
svg.text: Green Lantern power battery - wiring (budget build)
All ground symbols are one net. A dot is a joint; lines that cross without a dot do not connect.
C2 2200 µF 16 V (+ to the rail)
set it to 5.0 V with a meter
3.3 V logic. Program it over USB-C
the lock (on the lock wall in the sphere): one cable down behind the wall to the base
The pump and the LED strip are switched on their low side: + to the +12 V rail, - to the MOSFET drain, source to GND.
The 10 k resistors keep both MOSFETs off while the XIAO boots. D1 and D2 use the XIAO's internal pull-ups.
No master switch or fuse in this build: unplug the bank from the trigger board to turn it off; the bank has its own overcurrent cut-out.
